question: With which country did India sign a major defence agreement worth ₹63,000 crore on 28 April 2025, for the acquisition of 26 Rafale-Marine fighter jets?
solution:
The correct answer is __**France**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India signed a major defence agreement worth **₹63,000 crore** with **France** on **28 April 2025** for the acquisition of **26 Rafale-Marine fighter jets**.
 
• The Rafale-Marine jets are specifically designed for operations from **aircraft carriers** and are an adaptation of the land-based Rafale jets, which are already in service with the Indian Air Force.
 
• This deal strengthens India's defence ties with **France**, a longstanding strategic partner, and enhances India's naval combat capabilities.
 
• The agreement is part of India's broader efforts to modernize its armed forces and improve its maritime security in the **Indian Ocean Region (IOR)**.
 
• The **Rafale-Marine jets** will be deployed on India's indigenous aircraft carrier, **INS Vikrant**, which was commissioned in 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Rafale-Marine Fighter Jets:**

 
 
• The Rafale-Marine is the naval variant of the Rafale fighter jet manufactured by **Dassault Aviation, France**.
 
• It is capable of operating from aircraft carriers and is equipped with advanced technologies such as **active electronically scanned array (AESA) radar**, advanced weaponry, and electronic warfare systems.
 
• The jet has a **combat radius of approximately 1,850 km** and can carry a wide range of air-to-air and air-to-ground missiles.
 
• Its advanced features include **reduced radar cross-section, superior agility, and multi-role capabilities**, making it highly versatile in modern warfare.
 
 
 
• **India-France Defence Relations:**
 
 
• India and France have a robust strategic partnership, especially in the areas of **defence and aerospace.**
 
• In 2016, India signed a deal with France for the procurement of **36 Rafale fighter jets** for the Indian Air Force.
 
• The two countries also collaborate in areas such as **nuclear energy, space technology, and maritime security**.
 
• France supports India’s efforts to become self-reliant in defence manufacturing through initiatives like **Make in India**.
 
 
 
• **INS Vikrant:**
 
 
• INS Vikrant is India’s first indigenous aircraft carrier, commissioned in **2022**.
 
• It is designed to carry both fixed-wing aircraft like the Rafale-Marine and rotary-wing aircraft for various operational roles.
 
• Equipped with modern sensors and weapons, it enhances India’s capability to project power in the **Indian Ocean Region**.
 
• The addition of Rafale-Marine jets will significantly bolster INS Vikrant’s operational efficiency.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Deal:**
 
 
• The deal strengthens India’s maritime defence capabilities amidst growing challenges in the **Indian Ocean Region**.
 
• It signals India's focus on enhancing its blue-water navy and achieving strategic autonomy in defence.
 
• It aligns with India’s broader goals under initiatives like **Atmanirbhar Bharat** (self-reliant India).
 
• It also reflects the deepening bilateral ties between India and France in strategic and defence sectors.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Indian Ocean Region (IOR):**

 
 
• The IOR is a region of high strategic importance due to the presence of critical sea lanes and abundant natural resources.
 
• India has been strengthening its naval capabilities to secure its interests in the region amidst increasing activities by other powers such as **China**.
 
• The deployment of Rafale-Marine jets on INS Vikrant will enhance India’s ability to monitor and dominate the region.
 
 
 
• **Maritime Security:**
 
 
• Maritime security is critical for protecting trade routes, combating piracy, and ensuring regional stability.
 
• The Rafale-Marine jets, with their advanced capabilities, will play a key role in safeguarding India’s maritime interests.
